title: Error Handling: HTTPException & Custom Handlers
description: Raise HTTP exceptions and create custom exception handlers.

slides.title: Raising HTTP Exceptions
slides.content:
# HTTPException

FastAPI provides `HTTPException` to return error responses.

```python
from fastapi import HTTPException, status

@app.get("/items/{item_id}")
async def read_item(item_id: int):
    if item_id not in items:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Item not found")
    return items[item_id]
```

slides.title: Custom Exception Handlers
slides.content:
# Override Default Handlers

You can define custom handlers for specific exceptions or to globally modify error responses.

```python
from fastapi import Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

@app.exception_handler(MyCustomException)
async def custom_handler(request: Request, exc: MyCustomException):
    return JSONResponse(status_code=418, content={"message": exc.message})
```
